command:
mkdir -p "$HOME/Projects/walk-company" "$HOME/Projects/walk-notes/drafts" && printf 'plan
' > "$HOME/Projects/walk-notes/plan.md" && printf 'draft
' > "$HOME/Projects/walk-notes/drafts/one.txt" && printf 'secret.env
' > "$HOME/Projects/walk-notes/.gitignore" && printf 'x
' > "$HOME/Projects/walk-notes/secret.env" && ls -la "$HOME/Projects/walk-notes"
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "g" using {command down, shift down}'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "~/Projects/walk-company"' -e 'delay 1' -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 36'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 36'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "g" using {command down, shift down}'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "~/Projects/walk-notes"' -e 'delay 1' -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 36'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 36'
cd "$HOME/Projects/walk-notes" && git log --oneline && echo '--- tracked' && git ls-files && echo '--- status' && git status --porcelain && echo '--- remotes' && git remote -v && echo '--- end'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to true'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to false'
